text: You are swimming through a memory the ocean kept.
Long before these columns fell, this was a continent of builders,
a conglomerate people, many tribes grown into one,
who learned to touch the subtle energies of the world,
and in time to shape them.
For long ages they were agrarian and slow,
the way all deep things start.
Then swiftly, in the span of a few thousand years,
they floured into a technological mastery,
your own age is only beginning to imagine.
It did not begin in arrogance.
The teachers say the Atlanteans first called out for understanding,
for something truer than the life they knew,
with a sincere desire to be of service to one another,
and the call was answered.
Guidance came the way it always comes to those who ask and earnest.
But what they did with it, in time, out ran what they were.
The contact came first.
The machines came later.
The wisdom to hold both never fully arrived.
The teachers say they learned to work with the indigo ray,
the seat of inner vision,
drawing on the intelligent energy that moves through all things.
They could shape living forms.
They could move stone with thought.
What your engineers do with machines,
they did with the focused will.
And here the story turns, the way it always turns.
They used these gifts outwardly.
Wonders, weapons, dominion,
instead of turning them inward
to the healing and perfecting of their own beings.
Technique without wisdom.
Power without the disciplines of the heart.
The guides do not tell this part to shame them.
They tell it because it is the oldest pattern in the book of civilizations.
And because your own world is reading from the same page right now.
Twice war came.
The first took nearly half their number.
Bodies unmade by the very energies they had learned to wield.
The second remade the earth itself.
The sea rose and took the continent.
And the greater part of Atlantis was no more.
It was not only the wars.
The earth itself convulsed under what they had done.
The misused crystals, the weapons that split the deep forces of nature.
And the last of their great land masses
went down in the centuries that followed.
What the builders had raised with their minds.
The planet reclaimed with its body.
The teachers are gentle but clear about the sequence.
The distortion came first.
And the waters only finished what the distortion began.
Before the waters closed,
three groups of those who had kept their orientation toward the light
left for the high places of the world.
The mountains of the east of the south of the crossing lands.
Carrying what could be carried.
Seeds, star maps, memory.
Cosmic wisdom is direct about what sank here.
Not only a land but an experiment.
The experiment of whether a people could hold god-like technique
with a still mortal heart.
The answer that time was no.
And the teachers add something worth sitting with.
The energies of that experiment did not dissolve with the continent.
They are being rebalanced now in your lifetime
by the very souls who built and broke it.
If the story of Atlantis troubles you,
consider that you may have been there.
And that you are here to choose differently.
Do not make their error into a monument of guilt.
The ocean does not accuse.
It keeps.
These fallen rings and toppled stones are not a scolding.
They are a reminder, set in the deep
where only the patient will find it.
That every tool is a question.
And the question is always the same.
Will this serve the one who wields it?
Or will it serve all?
Swim gently among what remains.
Feel the scale of what they dreamed.
A whole civilization reaching for the infinite
with the hands of engineers.
Honor the reach.
Learn from the grasp.
And when you rise back toward the light,
carry the part of their story that matters.
The disciplines of the personality are the only technology
that cannot be turned into a weapon.
Everything else is borrowed.
That is owned.
The sea took their continent.
It could not take the lesson.
That one is still being delivered.
To you, here, now.
